confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence: they rest on 2026 guide snippets, and the cocktail and wine anchors are regular-menu rather than happy-hour prices. Hostel anchors are medium: they rest on Hostelz and Citiesinsider snippets, with July used as a low-season month. Hotel anchors are low confidence. The search snippets conflicted, and no 2026 CBD or 3-star ADR was confirmed, so the 3-star and 1-star figures are bounded inferences from whole-market ADR data and blog estimates. The FX rate comes from RBA snippets for 15 Oct 2026 and was not confirmed by opening the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Estimates are Sydney-specific, based on search snippets, general knowledge, and July (Australian winter, low season) pricing. The 3-star anchor sits below the citywide ADR because that figure includes 4- and 5-star hotels.
